trait_findings.education: A dated 2024 UCLA source establishes fourth-year attendance in anthropology and Chicana/o and Central American studies. Graduation is not claimed because the only purported completion statement came from an inaccessible original and was withheld.

trait_findings.military: No candidate military-service fact was found; her father's reported service was expressly not attributed to her.
